description: Estimates the federal income tax saved in 2025-2028 by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act overtime, tips and senior deductions combined. It applies each deduction's cap and phase-out, then runs taxable income through the IRS bracket tables for that year (Rev. Proc. 2024-40 for 2025, Rev. Proc. 2025-32 for 2026) before and after. 2027-2028 brackets are not published yet, so it uses 2026 and says so. Federal income tax only.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. married_filing_separately cannot claim these deductions.

hourly_rate.description: Regular hourly rate, if you want the premium computed from hours.

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income in USD: Form 1040 line 11b plus excluded Puerto Rico and foreign income (Schedule 1-A Part I).

qualified_overtime_premium.description: Qualified overtime premium (W-2 box 12 code TT).

spouse_age_65_or_older.description: Joint returns only. True if your spouse is 65+ on Dec 31.

tax_year.description: Tax year, 2025 to 2028. The deductions end after 2028.

taxable_income_before_new_deductions.description: Taxable income before these deductions. If left out it is approximated as MAGI minus the basic standard deduction.

taxpayer_age_65_or_older.description: True if you are 65+ on Dec 31 of the tax year.

name: estimate_tax_savings
title: Estimate federal tax saved
